description: This file defines a PHP class 'CurrentAndChangeEntitlement' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Leave\Dto'. The class encapsulates two arrays representing current leave entitlements and changes to those entitlements, providing constructor, getter, and setter methods.

classes.name: CurrentAndChangeEntitlement
